I want a Kubernetes cluster on AWS in eu-west-3, medium size with 3 nodes, for an application over HTTPS behind a WAF and a load balancer. On Azure, 3 small Linux VMs host the legacy customer database: confidential data, subject to GDPR, which must stay in the EU. A site-to-site VPN connects the cluster to the VMs, on ports 5432 and 9100. In the cluster: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki and a GitOps controller. NIS2 compliance. Budget of 1500 euros per month. Allowed regions: eu-west-3 and francecentral.
